info.name: Ouptel API v1
info.description:
# Ouptel API v1

Auto-generated from the Laravel route table - 406 endpoints.
Regenerate with `php artisan postman:generate` after changing routes.

## Getting started

1. Set the `base_url` collection variable to your environment host.
2. Run **Auth > Login**. A collection test script saves the returned
   token into the `token` variable automatically.
3. Every other request inherits `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`.

## Notes

- Request bodies and query parameters are derived from the
  controllers' validation rules, so the values are examples rather
  than fixtures - adjust them for your data.
- Optional multipart fields are included but disabled; enable the
  ones you need before sending.
- Session tokens come from `POST /api/v1/login` and are stored in the
  legacy `Wo_AppsSessions` table.
